name: mx-switch
title: Cherry MX switch on a board (reference)
orientation: Not printed: a model of the switch to check fits against, soldered to a board without a plate. The board's top is z = 0.

plate_at.rule: Where a plate's top would be: the bottom housing reaches down from here to the board

stem_top.rule: Top of the stem above the board

housing_top.rule: Top of the housing, where the stem comes out: a keycap sits on it

post_d.rule: The centre post, a little under its 4 mm hole

post_below.rule: The centre post's length into the board (it reaches through a 1.6 mm board)

sliver.rule: Thickness of the outlines that are hulled into the housing
